tolerance.reason: BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid does not return this volume twice. One binary compiled once and run ten times against the pinned v4.0.0-kernel.3 asset printed six distinct values, 1698.4365698478464 to 1698.4365698478477, a relative spread of 7.7e-16 or a few units in the last place of a double; the transcript's 1698.4365698478475 is one of them. Every other line of this probe, the other four offset volumes included, reproduces to the last digit on every run, so this is the measurement and not the machine. Declared as a tolerance rather than volatile because the volume IS what the record claims: the value stays compared, the non-numeric text has to match exactly, and 1e-14 is thirteen times the observed spread and two orders below the cap. The cause is #3003, which this does not close. #2965.
